notes.title: Bug fix part 2 + thanks
notes.content:
First, the cause of the freezes should be dealt with and the game should be more stable now. 
But please report any problems you may encounter so I can fix them.



Second, I want to thank all who supported my game, and those who reported the issues. =)

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
Hello,

A patch with a bug fix is now live, and should fix some issues some of you might have found in the game (some odd behaviours and crashes, mostly). 


Some issues have yet to be fixed (like some freezes), but I am working on it and should be dealt with soon.



Sorry for the inconvenience.
